messages:
jonas (sales): FYI — AcmeHealth asked for a blended pricing proposal. They want reserved capacity credits to apply toward burst overage for first 6 months. asking for per-token floor + overage cap.
elaine (product): got it. is this for Dedicated or Hosted? also can you paste expected commit size and burst profile?
jonas (sales): Dedicated. commit = 300 GPU-hours / month (~2.2B tokens). Peak bursts up to 3x for a week every quarter. customer wants simple language for contract: credits that reduce overage until consumed.
maria (finance): need clarity on how credits show up on invoices vs reserved commits. also want to model unit economics: blended vs strict overage. can you share ARR impact if we give a discount on overage?
jonas (sales): they expect ~20% blended discount on overage if we apply credits. willing to sign 12-mo if we soften overage rate for first 3 months.
elaine (product): high-level tradeoffs: 1) strict commit + separate overage rates (clear margin) 2) credits applied to overage (simpler for customer, fuzzy accounting) 3) temporary blended rate (timeboxed; easier to model). I'll draft 3 options.
arvind (eng): two engineering concerns: billing logic to apply credits in real-time vs post-hoc reconciliation; and routing: bursts should be able to overflow to shared capacity if dedicated saturated. both are doable but need time estimates.
oliver (solutions): for sales deck, we need an example calc. quick snippet helps.
elaine (product): plz add calc + assumptions to the intake card. sample calc below is fine to show customer.
oliver (solutions): posted calc: ```python
# simplified blended rate example
commit_cost = 30000  # $ per month for reserved pool
commit_tokens = 2_200_000_000
overage_cost = 0.000012  # $/token standard overage
# option: apply credits to first X tokens of overage
blended_rate = (commit_cost / commit_tokens) * 0.8 + overage_cost * 0.2
print(blended_rate)
```
maria (finance): that helps. we should run sensitivity: blended_rate +/- 10% and show P&L impact. also confirm tax/tier treatment for credits.
arvind (eng): small note: if credits are applied pre-tokenization (prefix crediting) we can avoid expensive per-token accounting in runtime; otherwise expect a billing job to run daily. implementation ETA: 2-3 sprints for safe rollout.
jonas (sales): customer wants decision within 10 business days. can product + finance give recommendation in 5?
elaine (product): aim for recommendation in 5 days. i'll own the product tradeoff doc and options. @maria can you run quick margin sims? @arvind please estimate implementation risk and whether we can pilot with a single customer without platform-wide changes.
maria (finance): will run sims, need the exact commit price and expected token mix.
arvind (eng): pilot path: enable credits via billing feature flag + reconciliation job; no infra changes to serving. risk: medium. estimate ETA for pilot: 3 weeks.
billing-bot: Invoice draft #ACC-9876 created for AcmeHealth (commit preview).
jonas (sales): thanks — i'll add commit numbers and expected token distribution to the intake ticket and loop legal.
elaine (product): next steps: 1) product doc with 3 options + recommended default 2) finance margin sims 3) eng pilot feasibility + ETA 4) sales to confirm contract language. I'll create intake card now and assign. :+1:
jonas (sales): perfect, thanks team. will follow up with customer update after we decide. :handshake:
